**Commentary of al-Mawardi (*al-Nukat wa al-Uyun*) on Surah 79, verses 15–26:**

﴿Has the story of Moses reached you?﴾ ﴿When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa.﴾ Regarding it there are two opinions:

One: This is the view of Mubashshir ibn Ubayd, that it is a valley in Ayla.

Two: This is the view of al-Hasan, that it is a valley in Filastin (Palestine).

Regarding ﴿al-muqaddas﴾ (the sacred) there are two interpretations:

One: It means blessed. This was said by Ibn Abbas.

Two: It means purified. This was said by al-Hasan: it was sanctified twice.

Regarding ﴿Tuwa﴾ there are four sayings. One: it is the name of the sacred valley. This was said by Mujahid, Qatada and Ikrimah.

Two: because he passed through the valley and folded it up (tawa). This was said by Ibn Abbas.

Three: because it was folded up with blessing. This was said by al-Hasan.

Four: it means "tread the valley with your foot." This was said by Ikrimah and Mujahid.

It may also bear a fifth meaning: that its sanctity was multiplied until he was purified from the defilement of sins, taken from the folding of a book (tayy al-kitab) when it is doubled.

﴿So say: Would you like to purify yourself?﴾ Regarding it there are two opinions:

One: "Would you like to submit (to Islam)?" This was said by Qatada.

Two: "Would you like to do good?" This was said by al-Kalbi.(p-198)

﴿So he showed him the greatest sign.﴾ Regarding it there are two opinions:

One: That it was his staff and his hand. This was said by al-Hasan and Qatada.

Two: That it was Paradise and Hell. This was said by al-Suddi.

It may also bear a third meaning: that it was his speech from the tree.

His words ﴿Then he gathered (his people) and proclaimed﴾ have two meanings:

One: He gathered the magicians for the contest and called out to his soldiers for battle.

Two: He gathered the people to attend and proclaimed, that is, he addressed them.

﴿So Allah seized him, as an example for the Hereafter and the first (life).﴾ Regarding it there are four sayings:

One: The punishment of this world and the next. Qatada said: Allah punished him in this world by drowning and in the Hereafter by the Fire.

Two: A punishment for the beginning of his life and its end. This was said by Mujahid.

Three: The first is his saying ﴿I know of no god for you other than myself﴾, and the last is his saying ﴿I am your Lord, the Most High﴾. This was said by Ikrimah. Ibn Abbas said: between the two there were forty years. Mujahid said: thirty years. al-Suddi said: the last was thirty years.

Four: The punishment of the first is the respite (given to him), and the last is the Fire, from the verse ﴿The Fire, to which they are exposed﴾, etc. This was said by al-Rabi'.
